runs.name: Bio-Techne Corporation
runs.entry: Price **$72.46** (close 2026-10-09, aggregator, flagged) x **156,818,238 shares** (10-K cover as of 2026-08-17, 0001104659-26-100322; one class; balance sheet 156,095,113 issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, repurchased shares retired; 156,800,296 at the merger record date 2026-08-11) = cap **$11,363M**; sovereign **5.60%** (UST 30Y par, 2026-10-09). The price is pinned by Merck KGaA's $73.00 cash merger (agreement 2026-06-25, 8-K 0001999371-26-013527; approved by shareholders 2026-09-23, 8-K 0001140361-26-037450; not yet closed); the run values the business and does not price the spread. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, as the overnight brief directs. Q1 IN (Protein Sciences decides, 91.3% of FY2022-FY2026 segment operating income; segment margin 41% to 47% every year FY2018-FY2026; growth not foreseeable: a 2022 target of revenue beyond $2 billion for 2026 against $1,215M filed). Q2 IN, narrowly (segment gross margin 75% to 77% and operating margin 41% to 47% across the FY2021-FY2022 boom and the downturn since; operating margin down five years running, 46.9% to 41.1%; FY2026 MD&A first names "pricing pressures"; the TOO HARD reading written down as the closest alternative). Q3 against (about $1,354.7M of purchases FY2017-FY2026 earning about 7.7% after tax even credited with all organic growth; Exosome Diagnostics bought for $251.6M, sold for about $15.0M; about $1B more due for Wilson Wolf by 2027-12-31). Q4 against, no STOP (ten balance sheets FY2017-FY2026: equity up $1,158M, retained earnings only $345M; inventory 10.7% to 16.1% of sales, looked at twice, nothing suspicious; $200M revolver due 2027-08-31 against $264.7M cash). Q5 integrity IN, ability against (excise-tax gross-ups of $25.4M granted 2026-06-23 after the buyer's final price was known, $16.5M of it the CEO's, his merger pay $52.9M; owners voted the merger pay down 96.4M shares to 25.9M; read as treatment of owners and carried to Q6; the analyst notes another reader could close at Q5 on [L2001-002], box still OUT). Q6 against (buybacks at $45.82 to $102.06, 1.8 to 4.0 times the Q7 bottom, share count still rising; pay on adjusted figures; the board declined an ROIC measure); narrower STOP does not arise (every purchase paid in cash). **Q7 OUT on the floor:** no case earns about ten percent at $72.46 (expected return 1.8% to 3.3% by case, below the 5.60% sovereign). Owner cash (operating cash less stock pay and all capital spending) FY2022-FY2026 $238.2M / $177.0M / $198.1M / $215.8M / $221.8M; all-equity average $224.3M before purchases, $120.7M after $103.6M a year of purchases. Range **$25.69-$26.87** all-equity (equity-only $23.89-$25.31; the literal window is the base, width 1.05 to 1): bottom purchases deducted with sales growth 2.39% (shown growth of 73.7% cut by (f)), top no purchases, no growth, maintenance-only spending (by (e)); fair **$13.96** all-equity ($12.85 equity-only). Q8 to Q12 not reached. Competitors: the 10-K names none; the analyst took Thermo Fisher, Danaher and Revvity from the merger proxy's peer list (a CONVENTION of the run), all SEC filers; on operating income plus amortization against tangible assets less cash 2017-2025 the whole field earns well above ordinary returns, TECH at or above its rivals throughout, its own return 55.6% to 30.1%. Could not get: Wilson Wolf's own figures (inferred from equity-method income); rivals' reagent segments; the 2021 and current price from an aggregator, flagged. Analyst's framework gaps for the operator: (1) Q7 conventions (c) and (e) conflict when a purchase-driven growth rate is cut by (f) (the purchases-deducted no-growth case, $21.00, not used, named); (2) (b)'s halves undefined for a five-year window; (3) no tax rate for the all-equity interest add-back (25% confessed); (4) no rule for rivals when the 10-K names none; (5) nothing on running a name under a signed cash merger; (6) no Q2 rule for a castle that held across a cycle and is slipping at its end; (7) the line between Q5's integrity STOP and Q6's treatment of owners is not drawn. Contamination declared by the analyst: a first name-filtered listing of Test Runs/ printed the names of an earlier TECH run file and research folder and 13 other companies' run file names, none opened; recorded as a breach of the rule in form. Seven commits (0289d743 to 50a32a36), one per question. Dispatcher quote check: 90 quoted fragments beside ids, 63 matched by the script; the 27 others are filer quotes attributed to the filer, framework wording or window artifacts where the fragment set directly before the id is in its row (L2008-005, L2001-002, M1995-064 checked by hand); no slip found; recorded, not fixed. no active v4.1 band to retire (TECH-rerun-band and TECH-floor-band already suspended while the merger agreement stands); v5 fair-price alert armed at $13.96. Position note filled at the fold: not held. check_framework PASS.
runs.narr: Q7 OUT on the floor at $72.46, a price pinned by Merck KGaA's $73.00 cash merger: range $25.69-$26.87 all-equity, fair $13.96; Q1 and Q2 IN on Protein Sciences (margins 41% to 47% through the cycle but down five years running, "pricing pressures" first named FY2026), Q3, Q4 and Q6 against on $1.35B of purchases earning about 7.7% and buybacks above any computed value, Q5 integrity IN with the excise-tax gross-ups at the sale carried. Seven framework gaps reported, chief among them Q7's (c) against (e) and no rule for a name under a signed cash merger.

The quote is pinned by Merck KGaA's $73.00 cash merger. A prompt to re-run Q7, never a verdict.
